instruction: You are given a `snappyHexMesh` template `/home/user/Desktop/snappy_base/`. Complete unstructured mesh generation and simulation from the command line: 1. Modify and create `/home/user/Desktop/cylinder_snappy/`: - Ensure the STL geometry file is available - Configure `snappyHexMesh` parameters (background mesh, surface snapping, boundary layers) - Generate the mesh and check mesh quality 2. Set boundary conditions and properties, then run the solver. 3. Extract wall `y+`. 4. Write a post-processing script to output `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt`: - Average cylinder-surface `yPlus` as `avg_yplus` - Format: `avg_yplus` 5. Do not use GUI tools. [Software] OpenFOAM is normally used from a shell after sourcing your installation environment (e.g. its `etc/bashrc`); `foamRun -help` verifies solver binaries are available.
